specs.Item Highlight: 5MP Sensor, AF and Manual Focus, 700mAh Battery, Type C Charging, Fill Light, Filters, Up to 32GB Card Support, 1/4in Mount

features: 4K Video and 64MP Photos: This sliding camera 4K model records video at up to 4K resolution and supports photo output up to 64MP. The supplied specification lists a 5MP image sensor for everyday travel and event photography.

AF and Manual Focus: Switch between autofocus and manual focus according to the subject and shooting situation. The 16X digital zoom helps frame distant scenes, portraits, group photos, and everyday moments.
2.8-Inch Flip Screen: The 4K sliding camera features a 2.8-inch 16:9 display for composing shots, reviewing recordings, and finding suitable viewing angles during photography or video capture.
Retro Sliding Design: The sliding digital camera combines a retro-style cover with an ABS body, built-in fill light, beauty mode, filters, time-lapse recording, and automatic or manual white balance.
Rechargeable Travel Camera: The included 700mAh NP6L lithium battery charges through the Type-C interface. The camera supports small memory cards up to 32GB, but the memory card is not included.
